name: The Physician
short: A masked doctor whose patient records predate the hospital itself.
story: A ledger was found sealed behind a wall during renovations. Its pages list patients who were never born and procedures that have no medical name. Every entry is signed by the same physician. The signature matches no known employee, but the mask in the attached sketch resembles a figure in the hospital's oldest painting.

name: The Red Key
short: A key with no matching lock. It is always warm, even in a freezer.
story: Recovered from an abandoned railway station, the key has no maker's mark and no known alloy composition. It grows warm when placed near sealed doors. Three witnesses claim they heard a lock turn from the other side, despite the key never having been inserted into anything.

name: The Last Bell
short: A small brass bell that rings once before an unexplained power outage.
story: The bell was found on the desk of an empty lighthouse. It has no clapper, yet its sound has been recorded on seven separate occasions. Each recording is followed by exactly eleven seconds of silence across every nearby radio frequency.

name: The Missing Hour
short: A report describing sixty minutes that do not appear on any clock.
story: The report describes a town where every clock stopped at 02:16. Residents remember a full hour of events, but official records show no passage of time. The document ends mid-sentence. The final page is covered in handwriting that matches the report's author, written twenty-three years before the author's birth.
